topic: How content extractors grade their output, how web tools read PDFs, and how challenge pages and soft 404s are detected, as a benchmark for Fetchproof's converter, completeness grade and capture acceptance
notes: Owner pages per unknown (U-1 trafilatura and htmldate docs; U-2 mozilla/readability README; U-3 jusText repository and the algorithm page at corpus.tools; U-4 Firecrawl scrape feature page and API reference; U-5 Cloudflare challenge docs; U-6 Google Search Central HTTP errors page; U-7 Common Crawl FAQ and get-started, IIPC WARC 1.1 specification). One targeted search where the owner page may not carry the whole fact (Firecrawl's per-page PDF credit cost), one scrape. Depth deep so maxScrapes is the cap: 15 pages planned of the lead's 16, one kept in reserve for a re-target. Phase 0 ran dry only: decompose would have spent five searches on the compound topic (ADR-0085) against a budget of three. Run 1 (2026-10-04): 14 collected, 1 failed - https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-challenges/challenge-types/challenge-pages/detect-challenge-page/ answered HTTP 404 and was dropped; the overview capture links the detection page at .../challenge-pages/detect-response/, collected in run 2 as the 16th scrape. The one search returned docs.firecrawl.dev/features/parse (collected).
